column1: # The events Sidecar's Qwen Code session-identity entry is installed under.
# This is a translation of QWEN_HOOK_EVENTS in Herdr's src/integration/mod.rs at
# HERDR_INTEGRATION_VERSION=1, and one row is all upstream has ever had: version
# 1 is the first release, no lifecycle rows were ever added and there is no
# QWEN_REMOVED_LIFECYCLE_HOOK_EVENTS list to correspond to. Upstream even names
# the asset herdr-agent-session.sh rather than herdr-agent-state.sh.
# `matcher` is `*`: install_qwen calls ensure_command_hook with Some("*"), as
# install_qodercli does and unlike install_devin and install_droid.
# `timeout_ms` is the fourth column, and it exists only in this file. Qwen counts
# a command hook's timeout in MILLISECONDS where every other provider in this
# group counts seconds, so the value is recorded here in its own unit rather
# than left to a reader to infer from a bare 10000.
